facts.fact: Public TUB notice 1725, dated 26 September 2026, says elevator maintenance led to a replacement shuttle between the Pórtico area, where Line 2 terminates, and Bom Jesus sanctuary. It describes the connection to Line 2 and has no announced end date.
facts.location: Public getnoticia response, result.object.desclonga; datainiciopubli and semfimprevisto fields.

notes: Actual HTTP200 public Angular content retrieved and read. The ordinary human page https://tub.pt/noticia/1725/ returned an Angular shell; its app.js and frontoffice/news/controllers.js identify the standard GET service, and services.js identifies core/request.php. No authentication, challenge bypass or private endpoint used. Exact retrieval URL, final URL, UTC and bodySHA preserved. No claim of a witnessed shuttle departure, fixed future operating hours or later reopening.
